title: Project kickoff
summary: Kick off a cross team project and leave with scope, owners and a first milestone.
goal: Agree the scope, owners and first milestone for the new onboarding project.
scenario: You're kicking off an eight week project to rebuild new user onboarding across three teams.

attendees.name: Tomas
likely_objections: Eight weeks is not realistic for three teams
The identity team hasn't agreed to anything yet
attendees.knows: Saw the last onboarding project slip by two months.

attendees.name: Mei
cares_about: owning the flow end to end
likely_objections: When does research happen if build starts in week one?
Who signs off on the design?
attendees.knows: Has interview notes from 12 new users that nobody has read yet.

attendees.name: Helen
likely_objections: What do you need from me to make this happen?
What's the first thing we'll see, and when?
attendees.knows: Sponsors the project and wants it live before the spring campaign in 10 weeks.

success: Everyone agrees the scope, the owners and the first milestone with a date.
tips: State the goal and how you'll measure it first.
Say what is out of scope before anyone asks.
Leave with a named owner and date for the first milestone.
ask: Agree the scope, owners and a first milestone in two weeks.
